generate_images_ddpm_gaudi: generate images using the GaudiDDPMPipeline with a UNet2DModel and DDPMScheduler on Habana Gaudi hardware
configure_gaudi_ddpm_pipeline: configure a GaudiDDPMPipeline with HPU graphs, bfloat16 full evaluation, and SDPA settings for optimized inference
run_ddpm_inference_steps: run DDPM denoising inference with a specified number of steps and batch size on the Gaudi accelerator
review_gaudi_ddpm_output_class: review the GaudiDDPMPipelineOutput dataclass that returns generated images and throughput metrics
refactor_ddpm_scheduler_support: refactor the GaudiDDPMPipeline to support both DDPMScheduler and DDIMScheduler for flexible denoising strategies
